correctness.rationale: All 4096 edge subsets, 1698 faces and 7980 Hasse incidences are generated from explicit definitions; 847 matched pairs are disjoint and their reversal gives an acyclic digraph, leaving one critical vertex and three critical five-cells. A separate mod-two chain calculation agrees. For all 48 cube automorphisms, signed simplicial fixed-face Lefschetz traces and independently evaluated signed edge-orbit unions give exactly the displayed irreducible character. These are finite exhaustive verifications with a reproducible standalone script, not a mere log; no unproved general parameter theorem is asserted.

value.rationale: A full automorphism character of a natural finite cubical bounded-degree complex is more structural than ordinary homology rank. The irreducible three-dimensional twist, antipodal minus-identity action and absence of invariants distinguish equivariant information invisible to nonequivariant sphere-wedge type. The canonical high-symmetry graph and exact complete classification motivate the specific calculation. It is a bounded natural classification with no exaggerated downstream claims.
